title: CLI Session Replay
description: Deep dive into a single Claude Code CLI session with conversation replay

list.name: session_id
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT s.id AS __value, s.id || ' | ' || p.display_name || ' | ' || LEFT(COALESCE(s.title, 'untitled'), 60) || ' (' || TO_CHAR(s.started_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') || ')' AS __text FROM sessions.sessions s JOIN sessions.projects p ON s.project_id = p.id ORDER BY s.started_at DESC LIMIT 200

targets.rawSql: SELECT duration_seconds / 60.0 FROM sessions.sessions WHERE id = ${session_id}
SELECT total_messages FROM sessions.sessions WHERE id = ${session_id}
SELECT total_turns FROM sessions.sessions WHERE id = ${session_id}
SELECT total_tool_calls FROM sessions.sessions WHERE id = ${session_id}
SELECT files_created FROM sessions.sessions WHERE id = ${session_id}
SELECT files_modified FROM sessions.sessions WHERE id = ${session_id}
SELECT 1 AS value, COALESCE(model, 'unknown') AS model FROM sessions.sessions WHERE id = ${session_id}
SELECT 1 AS value, source FROM sessions.sessions WHERE id = ${session_id}
SELECT input_tokens + output_tokens AS total_tokens FROM sessions.sessions WHERE id = ${session_id}

SELECT m.type, m.role, m.content_text, m.content_json::text AS content_json, TO_CHAR(m.timestamp, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS time_str, m.model, m.sequence_num FROM sessions.messages m WHERE m.session_id = ${session_id} AND m.type IN ('user', 'assistant') ORDER BY m.sequence_num ASC LIMIT 500

SELECT a.file_path AS "File Path", a.action AS "Action", a.language AS "Language", a.size_bytes AS "Size", LEFT(a.content_preview, 100) AS "Preview", TO_CHAR(a.timestamp, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "Time" FROM sessions.artifacts a WHERE a.session_id = ${session_id} ORDER BY a.timestamp ASC
SELECT tool_name AS "Tool", COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM sessions.tool_calls WHERE session_id = ${session_id} GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT agent_id AS "Agent", COALESCE(agent_type, 'unknown') AS "Type", COALESCE(description, '') AS "Description", total_messages AS "Messages", TO_CHAR(started_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "Started" FROM sessions.subagents WHERE parent_session_id = ${session_id} ORDER BY started_at ASC

SELECT s.session_uuid AS "UUID", p.project_path AS "Project Path", s.git_branch AS "Git Branch", s.cli_version AS "CLI Version", s.source AS "Source", s.status AS "Status", s.input_tokens AS "Input Tokens", s.output_tokens AS "Output Tokens", s.cache_read_tokens AS "Cache Read", s.cache_creation_tokens AS "Cache Created", TO_CHAR(s.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Started", TO_CHAR(s.ended_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Ended" FROM sessions.sessions s JOIN sessions.projects p ON s.project_id = p.id WHERE s.id = ${session_id}
